results.title: AgentGrid.io: Shared workspace for humans and agents | Product Hunt
results.content:
What do you think? …

Avishay Cohen

Hey PH 👋

Avishay here, co-founder of Anima, makers of AgentGrid.io.  
Today, we're launching AgentGrid.io, a shared drive for humans and AI agents to collaborate on documents, websites, apps, and designs. Feels like Google Drive for humans, Git for agents.  
  
Bring your own AI agents. Keep your work independent of any AI provider.   
Everyone works on the same live artifacts.

What you can do with AgentGrid:

Collaborate on documents - Google Docs-like multiplayer editing for humans, with a Markdown and Git interface for agents.

Share/publish websites and apps - HTML/React apps are a new type of document - reports, slides, designs, internal apps - Share them securely or publish to the web, simply by asking your chat/agent. [...] Multi-agent-human collab - Let Claude create a report, ChatGPT improve it, Grok Bot generate visuals, and a teammate edit it manually. All on the same artifact.

Share AI work securely - Give every document, report, app, or design a persistent link and structured storage, instead of leaving it buried in a chat.

Version history and control - See who changed what, restore previous versions, and control what each agent can access or modify.

Agent-agnostic, made for all agents - Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok Bot, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, and others via MCP, CLI, and APIs.

Bring your existing work - Import files, websites, and Figma designs to continue working with your agents. You can also ask your agents to simply put their work on AgentGrid.io.

Who it's for: [...] Who it's for:

Anyone creating real work with AI.

Founders, builders, designers, developers, marketers, product teams, agencies, and companies bringing AI agents into their daily workflows.

AgentGrid.io is Free to start: Unlimited agent seats.

Try it with your existing Claude, Grok Bot, or ChatGPT. Connect AgentGrid and ask:  
"Share this with me on AgentGrid.io."  
  
Why we built AgentGrid.io:  
Since the launch of OpenClaw and Hermes, we've been working alongside AI agents across Marketing, Engineering, BI, QA, CS, and more.

AI agents are not like humans, but they are becoming teammates we collaborate with, and we need an easy way to do that. We built AgentGrid for ourselves, and today we're opening it to everyone.
